plot_next_token_distribution: plot the probability distribution of the top next tokens given a prompt and model logits
plot_word_frequencies: plot a log-log frequency vs rank chart for a Counter of word token frequencies
plot_data_and_decision_boundary: plot 2D data points with a binary classification decision boundary, weight vector, and orthogonal points
plot_loss_curve: plot the training and optional validation loss curve from a Keras model history dictionary
visualize_mlp_architecture: visualize the architecture of a multi-layer perceptron with input, hidden, and output layer dimensions
